theme.title: Around the League
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The 1971–72 Lakers set the NBA record for consecutive wins. How long was the streak?
questions.note: 33 in a row, an NBA record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they would also go on an NBA record 33-game winning streak

funFacts.text: Coach Bill Sharman replaced the Lakers' old habits with strict conditioning and an up-tempo fast break.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He introduced strict conditioning drills and implemented a running fast break-based offense

funFacts.text: Wilt's job changed: rather than hunt shots, he rebounded and started fast breaks with quick outlet passes.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: focus on defense, rebounding, and jump-starting the fast break with quick outlet passes

funFacts.text: The transition style proved too demanding for the injured Elgin Baylor, whose retirement opened a starting job for Jim McMillian.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He was replaced at small forward by Jim McMillian

questions.prompt: Devin Booker became the youngest player to score 60 or more, at 20, in a regular-season game. How many points did he score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Devin Booker (70 points; 20 years and 145 days)

funFacts.text: Booker's historic scoring performance came in a loss to Boston rather than a Phoenix victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: against the Boston Celtics, Booker became the sixth player in NBA history to score 70 points in a game

funFacts.text: His night was not just shooting: he also supplied eight rebounds and six assists for the Suns.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Booker also added eight rebounds and six assists in 45 minutes

funFacts.text: Booker's scoring average jumped sharply in his second pro season as his role in Phoenix expanded.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Booker ended the season averaging 22.1 points per game, a near 9-point increment

questions.prompt: What was Dennis Rodman's career high in rebounds, set in March 1992?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In a March 1992 game, Rodman grabbed a career-high 34 rebounds.

funFacts.text: The rising Knicks eliminated the aging Detroit Pistons in the first round of that spring's playoffs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the aging Pistons were eliminated by the up-and-coming New York Knicks in the first round

funFacts.text: Longtime coach Chuck Daly resigned not long after, a blow to Rodman, who saw him as a father figure.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: coach Chuck Daly, whom he had admired as a surrogate father, resigned

funFacts.text: Before rebounding defined his legend, Rodman won consecutive Defensive Player of the Year awards.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: won his second Defensive Player of the Year Award

questions.prompt: John Stockton's career high in assists came on January 15, 1991. How many?
questions.context: Utah Jazz vs San Antonio Spurs · 1990–91

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On January 15, 1991, Stockton scored 20 points and dished out a career-high and franchise-record 28 assists

funFacts.text: Stockton also scored 20 points in the same home win against San Antonio.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton scored 20 points and dished out a career-high

funFacts.text: Utah won that game 124–102 at home against the Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in a 124–102 home win against the San Antonio Spurs

funFacts.text: In 1995, Stockton passed Magic Johnson to become the league's all-time assists leader.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he passed Magic Johnson (who had 9,921 assists) as the NBA's all-time leader in assists

questions.prompt: LeBron James scored 44 points in Game 1 of the 2015 Finals. How many shots did he take?
questions.context: 2015 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Golden State

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James had a career NBA Finals high of 44 points, while attempting a postseason career-high 38 shots

funFacts.text: Kyrie Irving blocked a potential go-ahead Stephen Curry layup late in Game 1's regulation.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry beat Kyrie Irving to the basket and went for a go-ahead layup, but Irving blocked the shot

funFacts.text: The Cavaliers' offense scored just one basket in overtime, and Golden State took the series opener.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Cleveland's only score in the extra period was James' layup

funFacts.text: Irving fractured his left kneecap during overtime, joining injured Kevin Love on Cleveland's sideline.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he was diagnosed with a fractured left kneecap that would require surgery and was ruled out for the rest of the Finals
